articles.summary: Under new EU rules, crops improved without adding foreign DNA will be treated like conventionally bred crops, validating the approach Cibus has developed for 25 years SAN DIEGO, June 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cibus, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBUS) today welcomed a landmark decision by the European Union.
articles.title: Europe Recognizes Nature-Based Plant Improvement, Opening a New Pathway for Cibus
